name: Rupesh Tiwari
title: AWS Senior Customer Solutions Manager
tagline: From Senior Engineer to FAANG Leader - Now Helping You Do The Same
story: I spent 20+ years navigating the tech industry - from hands-on coding to leading teams at enterprise scale. I've sat on both sides of the FAANG interview table.
After joining AWS as a Senior CSM, I realized something: the gap between talented engineers and their dream roles wasn't skill - it was how they communicated their value.
That's why I started coaching. Not to sell you frameworks, but to help you articulate the leader you already are.

philosophy.title: My Coaching Philosophy
points: No scripts or templates - we build YOUR authentic stories
Bar-raiser perspective - I know what interviewers actually look for
Outcome-focused - every session moves you closer to your offer
